Rank 06 - Education

School and Coaching Fee Collection

Coaching centers and small schools live on monthly fees. Due tracking and parent reminders create immediate cash-flow value.

Calculate revenue Open overview

Suggested package

BDT 8,000Installation/setup fee
BDT 500Recommended monthly charge

BDT 500/month is fair for institutions collecting recurring fees. Charge more by student count if usage grows.

8.0Practical score based on daily pain, willingness to pay, support load, and expansion potential.
BDT 8,000Default setup used in calculator.
BDT 500Suggested monthly price after support-cost thinking.
BDT 14,000,000Gross year-one revenue at 1,000 businesses.

Why this can work

Private education surveys report nearly 100,000 private education institutions and about 6,600 registered coaching centers. Unregistered coaching centers make the practical base larger.

Fees are late, receipts are manual, attendance is separate, and parents need reminders every month.

You stop chasing fees from notebooks. The due list is ready every day.

Validation signals

  • Registered coaching centers number in the thousands.
  • Private education institutions are near 100,000.
  • Fee collection is monthly and painful.
  • Parents accept phone reminders.

MVP modules

  • Student list
  • Monthly fee
  • Due and paid status
  • Attendance
  • Receipt
  • Parent reminder text
  • Class-wise collection report

Do not build first

  • Do not build full school ERP first.
  • Do not add live class/video.
  • Do not include unlimited SMS in subscription.

Money model

Change the inputs and see the business case instantly.

Use support cost as a reality check. Low monthly pricing looks attractive until support eats the margin.

First 30-day launch plan

  • Start with coaching centers, not large schools.
  • Import students from Excel.
  • Make receipt and due list excellent.
  • Add attendance after fee workflow is working.

Risks and fixes

Risks
  • School ERP expectations can explode scope.
  • Institutions may require many report formats.
  • Payment collection integrations add complexity.
Mitigations
  • Position as fee collection, not full ERP.
  • Use fixed report templates.
  • Add payment later.
